source.note: The envelope is the page's labels example verbatim (`{"status":"success","data":["foo","bar","baz"]}`); the three label names are the harness's. The window is six hours wide because the page states that `start` "defaults to 6 hours ago" — the port's `labels()` takes no time arguments, so the adapter sends that window explicitly from its injected clock rather than relying on a server default.
The envelope is the page's `/loki/api/v1/label/<name>/values` example verbatim (`["cat","dog","axolotl"]`); the two values are the harness's.
